entries.name: MacTeX
entries.description: Most common LaTeX distribution for macOS, basically TeXLive with some Mac-specific tools added.

entries.name: TeX Live
entries.description: Most common LaTeX distribution for Unix-like operating systems, including GNU/Linux. Also works on Windows.

entries.name: MikTeX
entries.description: Most common LaTeX distribution for Windows, but also available for Mac, Linux or as Docker image.

entries.name: reitzig/texlive-docker
entries.description: minimal TeXLive system with package installation possibility

entries.name: Island of TeX/texlive
entries.description: debian-based full TeXLive system

entries.name: dante-ev/docker-texlive
entries.description: debian-based full TeXLive system with additions with pandoc, perl, and python pre-installed

entries.name: pdfTeX
entries.description: TeX compiler that produces PDF files immediately instead of DVI files (nowadays, this is the standard compiler for many users).

entries.name: XeTeX
entries.description: TeX compiler that provides better unicode and font support than TeX/pdfTeX (i.e. you can use the fonts of your operating system instead of only TeX fonts).

entries.name: LuaTeX
entries.description: (La)TeX compiler that supports Lua code for scripting and has improved unicode and font support than standard TeX/pdfTeX.

entries.name: tectonic
entries.description: Modern, self contained (La)TeX compiler powered by XeTeX and TeXLive.

entries.name: Auto-LaTeX Equations with Google Docs
entries.description: Render high-quality math equations directly in Google Docs.

entries.name: MathJaX
entries.description: JavaScript engine to render mathematical formulas on the web. The outcome looks really slick.

entries.name: mimeTeX
entries.description: mimeTeX is a rather old tool to render LaTeX formulas to PNG figures for your web site, without actually needing a LaTeX installation on your server.

entries.name: mathTeX
entries.description: mathTeX is the successor of mimeTeX: it produces nicer-looking images but it requires LaTeX to be installed on your server.

entries.name: KaTeX
entries.description: KaTeX is a math rendering library made by Khan Academy focusing on fast load times. All output is processed as plain HTML instead of fixed images.

entries.name: Franklin.jl
entries.description: Static site generator with KaTeX support, code evaluation, LaTeX-like commands and optional pre-rendering, in Julia.

entries.name: xhub
entries.description: Browser extension that lets you use LaTeX in GitHub pages.

entries.name: List of popular LaTeX editors
entries.description: Community-maintained list of popular LaTeX editors including a screenshot and a short description.

entries.name: Kile
entries.description: Great LaTeX editor originally from the Linux/KDE community. It runs fine on Windows and macOS as well.

entries.name: TeXMaker
entries.description: Pretty good alternative to Kile.

entries.name: TeXStudio
entries.description: Cross-platform LaTeX editor that stems from TeXMaker.

entries.name: WinEdt
entries.description: The LaTeX editor many people swear by. Only for .

entries.name: TeXnicCenter
entries.description: Quite old but free and decent editor for LaTeX.

entries.name: LyX
entries.description: Cross-platform WYSIWYM editor that uses LaTeX behind the scenes to render documents.

entries.name: TeXShop
entries.description: No-nonsense editor for LaTeX documents which is included in MacTeX.

entries.name: TeXWorks
entries.description: No-nonsense editor for LaTeX code, modeled after TeXShop, but this one is cross-platform.

entries.name: BakomaTex
entries.description: Commercial LaTeX editor that allows to edit your document both using its source code and WYSIWYG.

entries.name: Texifier
entries.description: Commercial LaTeX editor for macOS and iOS, with excellent features (document overview, synchronised PDF display, autocompletion, sync across devices, etc.) that never get in the way of writing.

entries.name: TeX64
entries.description: Native macOS LaTeX editor with AI-powered error fixing, equation OCR, live PDF preview, and structured math editing.

entries.name: Oleafly
entries.description: Free, open-source desktop editor for LaTeX, Typst, and Markdown with live PDF preview, SyncTeX, bundled engines, and Git-native projects.

entries.name: LaTeXTools
entries.description: Atom port of the Sublime Text package of the same name.

entries.name: LaTeXing
entries.description: Free plug-in to edit LaTeX.

entries.name: LaTeXTools
entries.description: Free LaTeX plugin for Sublime Text.

entries.name: AucTeX
entries.description: Emacs plugin for LaTeX that also shows a preview of equations and figures.

entries.name: RefTeX
entries.description: Emacs plugin for LaTeX that adds support for labels, references, and citations.

entries.name: LaTeX Live Preview
entries.description: Instantly previews your LaTeX document.

entries.name: vimtex
entries.description: Modern vim plugin for editing LaTeX files. Has a variety of features including live preview and forward search.

entries.name: TeXiFy-IDEA
entries.description: Free LaTeX plugin for IntelliJ IDEA.

entries.name: LaTeX Workshop
entries.description: LaTeX extension for Visual Studio Code

entries.name: a-nau/latex-devcontainer
entries.description: Devcontainer setup for easy LaTeX usage without local installation

entries.name: List of popular online LaTeX editors
entries.description: Community-maintained list of popular online LaTeX editor including equation editors.

entries.name: Authorea
entries.description: Online editor with built-in git support and bibliography tools.

entries.name: OpenAI Prism
entries.description: Online editor with realtime collaboration features.

entries.name: Modern LaTeX Editor
entries.description: Online editor, no-signup hybrid code editor + visual editor that mixes Notion/Google docs/Microsoft Word-like editing with raw LaTeX code blocks.

entries.name: Octree
entries.description: Online editor with AI writing assistance.

entries.name: Androma TeX Editor
entries.description: Collaborative LaTeX editor integrated into a mathematics wiki, with issue tracking, pull requests, and WASM-based compilation.

entries.name: olcli
entries.description: Command-line interface for Overleaf to sync, manage, and compile projects from the terminal.

entries.name: Overleaf
entries.description: Online editor, also with a WYSIWYM editor and git support. Also available as Overleaf Community Edition (self-hosted, AGPL licensed).

entries.name: SciTeX Cloud
entries.description: Self-hostable online editor with AI assistant integration, figure/table/citation management, real-time collaboration, and an MCP server (29 tools).

entries.name: WebLaTeX
entries.description: Web-based vscode with Git Integration + Copilot + Grammar & Spell Checker + Live Collaboration Support based on GitHub Codespace and Dev container.

entries.name: Papeeria
entries.description: Online editor with built-in git support.

entries.name: JaxEdit
entries.description: Online LaTeX editor with Live Preview and nice presentation mode.

entries.name: Vexlio
entries.description: Online diagram editor with built-in LaTeX equation support including live preview and easy exports.

entries.name: TeXbrain
entries.description: Free, open-source browser-based LaTeX editor with in-browser compilation, live PDF preview and Git integration. No account or install required.

entries.name: LetX
entries.description: Online editor with real-time multi-author collaboration (CRDT), bidirectional SyncTeX, and 1000+ journal/thesis templates.

entries.name: Sarmate.net
entries.description: Online editor with 5 built-in WYSIWYG helpers (TikZ figures, probability trees, sign tables, color boxes, LaTeX tables) that auto-generate clean LaTeX code. Cloud compilation, real-time collaboration, free tier.

entries.name: TexLab
entries.description: Language server for LaTeX and BibTeX with completion, definitions, references, rename, formatting, and forward search.

entries.name: Badness
entries.description: Language server, formatter, and linter for LaTeX built on a lossless, error-tolerant syntax tree in the style of rust-analyzer.

entries.name: JabRef
entries.description: Very powerful cross-platform (Java) bibtex editor.

entries.name: Papis
entries.description: Extremely customizable, powerful and simple cross-platform (Python) library manager. It has a very complete Command-Line-Interface, several GUIs and scripting capability.

entries.name: Bibdesk
entries.description: Great bibliography editor for .

entries.name: Zotero
entries.description: Reference manager for your browser that also exports to bibtex and integrates with many LaTeX editors.

entries.name: Mendeley
entries.description: Both an app and cloud client to manage your references and PDFs. Can sync out to a bibtex file for your LaTeX workflow.

entries.name: betterbib
entries.description: Command-line utility for improving your BibTeX files. Fetches information from online sources.

entries.name: OneCite
entries.description: Universal citation management and academic reference toolkit that converts messy references into perfectly formatted citations. Supports DOI, arXiv ID, titles, and more, with output in BibTeX, APA, and MLA formats.

entries.name: CrossRef Local
entries.description: Local CrossRef database (167M papers) with full-text search, impact factor data, Python API for bibliography enrichment, and an MCP server (15 tools).

entries.name: OpenAlex Local
entries.description: Local OpenAlex database (284M scholarly works) with abstracts and semantic search for literature discovery, and an MCP server.

entries.name: Arara
entries.description: (GitHub repo) - Simple tool that allows you to specify which tools to call inside your document and it can be extended quite easily.

entries.name: latexmk
entries.description: Build tool that is the commonly used by many LaTeX editors (LaTeXing, TeXShop, etc.) to build your LaTeX files.

entries.name: xu-cheng/latex-action
entries.description: GitHub Action to compile LaTeX documents

entries.name: dante-ev/latex-action
entries.description: DANTE e.V.'s GitHub action to compile LaTeX documents. Offers a full TeXLive and pre-installed perl and python.

entries.name: CaTeX
entries.description: Concatenates LaTeX documents with attention for properly merging the preamble.

entries.name: Pandoc
entries.description: This program converts almost any document format (LaTeX, DOC, markdown, etc.) to almost any other format. A great tool to aid workflows where multiple formats are used.

entries.name: SciTeX Writer
entries.description: Manuscript compilation system with templates for manuscripts, revisions, and supplementary materials, plus figure, table, and citation handling, and an MCP server (38 tools).

entries.name: latexindent
entries.description: Perl script that indents and reformats LaTeX documents, highly configurable through YAML settings and shipped with the major TeX distributions.

entries.name: tex-fmt
entries.description: Extremely fast LaTeX formatter written in Rust, with sensible defaults and minimal configuration.

entries.name: ChkTeX
entries.description: Linter / code checker for LaTeX documents.

entries.name: blacktex
entries.description: Command-line tool that replaces commonly occurring LaTeX anti-patterns and cleans up your files.

entries.name: TeXtidote
entries.description: A cross-platform (Java) spelling, grammar and style checker for LaTeX documents.

entries.name: latex2arxiv
entries.description: CLI tool that prepares a LaTeX project for arXiv submission: prunes unreachable files, strips draft markup, validates the bibliography, and catches desk-rejection errors before upload. Also available as a GitHub Action and MCP server for AI agents.

entries.name: Codecogs Eqn Editor
entries.description: Online LaTeX equation editor that allows you to produce figures containing an equation.

entries.name: EqualX
entries.description: Graphical LaTeX formula editor.

entries.name: KLaTeXFormula
entries.description: Cross-platform alternative for LaTeXit.

entries.name: Laeqed
entries.description: Crossplatform LaTeX formula to PNG convertor.

entries.name: LaTeXEqEdit
entries.description: LaTeX formula editor for Windows.

entries.name: LaTeXiT
entries.description: LaTeXit is an equation editor that makes it easy to drag-and-drop rendered equations (as PDF, PNG, etc.) into your non-LaTeX documents on the Mac.

entries.name: LaTeX to Image
entries.description: Convert LaTeX to PNG, JPEG, or SVG images. Big symbols menu and easy drag-and-drop equations.

entries.name: pix2tex
entries.description: LaTeX OCR

entries.name: Image to LaTeX
entries.description: AI-powered converter that transforms images of handwritten notes, equations, or tables into clean LaTeX code.

entries.name: TikzEdt
entries.description: (also: GitHub repo) - WYSIWYG and text-based editor for TikZ pictures.

entries.name: TikZ-Editor
entries.description: Live-previewing editor for TikZ figures.

entries.name: IPE
entries.description: Drawing tool that integrates well with LaTeX commands and documents.

entries.name: GeoGebra
entries.description: Cross-platform geometry tool with output to TikZ.

entries.name: Dia
entries.description: Cross-platform diagramming tool that can export to PSTricks and MetaPost code.

entries.name: TikZiT
entries.description: GUI tool for creating graphs and string diagrams using PGF/TikZ.

entries.name: LaTeXDraw
entries.description: Vector-based drawing tool having LaTeX as first-class citizen.

entries.name: csv2latex
entries.description: Converts CSV files from your favorite programs to LaTeX tabulars.

entries.name: Tables Generator

entries.name: pgfplotstable

entries.name: tikzplotlib

entries.name: TikZBlog

entries.name: OpenTikZ

entries.name: microtype
